blockage.none: The present signature carries no blockage sequence, yet it may still align more clearly with Destiny.
blockage.fallback: A repeated pattern in the triangle arrests the flow of the signature.
blockage.generic: The sequence {{code}} arrests the flow of the signature and calls for rectification.
blockage.1: The 111 arrests initiative: the signature shouts instead of leading, and doors close from excess force.
blockage.2: The 222 paralyzes decision. Contracts, bonds, and paths waver — the signature chooses no course.
blockage.3: The 333 scatters expression. Ideas and gifts disperse without taking form in Destiny.
blockage.4: The 444 is the classic blockage of matter: money, dwelling, and recognition stall upon the repeated stroke.
blockage.5: The 555 unsettles the course. Changes begin and do not hold — the signature finds no ground.
blockage.6: The 666 unbalances the nest. Family, duty, and affection weigh upon the written identity.
blockage.7: The 777 isolates the quest. Wisdom closes, and the signature no longer speaks with the world.
blockage.8: The 888 arrests power. Authority and resources circle without a prosperous harvest.
blockage.9: The 999 forbids closure. Ancient cycles do not end, and the signature bears what ought already to have departed.
